DELIVERY POLICY

Digital service delivery

Last updated: 1 October 2026

Surecomply Services provides digital services remotely. No physical products are shipped under these service offerings.

Delivery timeline

The estimated completion date or project milestones are agreed in writing before work begins. Timing depends on the project scope, receipt of any agreed payment, access to necessary materials, and your feedback or approvals.

How deliverables are provided

Final deliverables are sent by email, a download link, or another delivery method agreed in the quote. Website projects may include a source-file handover or deployment to an account you control, as specified in the scope. The quote identifies the file formats and whether editable source files are included.

Review and revisions

You can review the deliverables against the agreed scope. Included revisions and any review period are specified in your project agreement. Work beyond the agreed scope requires an additional quote and your acceptance.

Delays

We will communicate any known delay and discuss a revised schedule. Delays in your materials, access, or feedback may change the timeline. If we cannot complete the agreed service, the refund and cancellation policy applies.

Access problems

If you cannot open or download a delivered file, contact aj@tndn.in with your project reference so we can help with delivery.
